content.short: Colony is a complete no-code toolkit for building DAOs.
content.description: Colony was created by Jack du Rose and Aron Fischer to streamline the DAO creation process. With Colony, anyone can launch a functional DAO without writing code, and a basic setup can be completed in under a minute. The platform allows you to integrate your token, oversee its sale, and govern your DAO with ease, providing a cohesive toolkit to manage membership, tasks, and decisions from a single interface. It all happens in a single, clear workflow.
